findings.title: A photo saved by tapping it during a Save all download batch is downloaded twice
findings.why: tap() fixes the `ready` list before the first `await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP)` and never checks `handed` again before each download. A batch of 12 takes about 4.4 s. If the user taps one of those prints in that time, save() in web/index.html downloads it and adds it to saveAll.handed, and then the batch downloads it again. The ticket says the handed-over flag means 'nothing is downloaded twice'. Fix: skip any `ready[i]` whose pid is already in `handed` when its turn comes.

findings.title: A share sheet promise that never settles locks Save all for the rest of the session
findings.why: `busy` is set and `await share(list)` has no cap or timeout. navigator.share can stay pending, for example when the page is hidden mid-share or after some dismissals in WebKit. When that happens `busy` never clears, so every later tap only toasts 'Still saving' and Save all can't be used again until reload. This goes against Rule 3 ('Nothing waits forever… a wait that gives up tells its caller'). The wait is on the OS share sheet, not on another device, so it is Low. Fix: cap the wait with a named timeout, or don't let a pending share block later taps.
